findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include the trace ID
findings.body: This replaces the direct `Info` call after the middleware removed its `tracing.TraceIDFromContext` handling. The new contextual logger middleware adds endpoint and plugin details, but does not add a trace ID, so completed plugin request log entries lose the `traceID` field even when the request is traced. This breaks log-to-trace correlation for these requests.
